messages:
matt: quick heads-up — small but consistent error spike on embed service in eu1 during canary. seeing ~4% 5xxs for the last 3 minutes. suspect tokenizer path regression in the quant build. need expedited approval to push v1.3.2-hotfix1 to canary+rollforward window. @ops-oncall can you stand by?

sasha: ack. can you paste the exact image/tag and the change that fixes it?

matt: image: `redwood/embed-service:v1.3.2-hotfix1` — patch: revert accidental float->int cast in tokenizer decode (commit ab12cf9). small binary, rollback is just pin previous image. intended canary: 5% -> 25% over 20m if healthy.

li: quick review done — change is tiny and tests pass. no obvious perf regression in local smoke. +1 from me.

ops-oncall: i'm on standby. timeline? change window available now until 12:00UTC. if you push, i'll watch and can trigger rollback if errors >3% sustained for 3m or >6% for 1m.

matt: plan: deploy canary now to 5%, wait 3m, if OK push to 25% over 15m, then full roll at 45m. rollback criteria as ops said. release notes stub: https://redwood.internal/release/1.3.2-hotfix1 (private).

eric: +1 for expedited. two approvals (li + sasha) enough per policy? we usually need one eng-release lead. @sasha?

sasha: i approve expedited. this matches hotfix criteria (customer-facing 5xx spike). :thumbsup:

release-bot: Release note draft created — https://redwood.internal/release-drafts/1.3.2-hotfix1 — include note: "tokenizer decode cast fix; reduces eu embed 5xx"

deploy-bot: request received: `deploy canary --service=embed-service --image=redwood/embed-service:v1.3.2-hotfix1 --pct=5`

deploy-bot: canary rollout started -> `5%` (eu1). health checks passing: 20/20.

matt: monitoring dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/embed/eu1?from=-5m to monitor 5xx and tail latency. watching logs for decode errors.

ops-oncall: seeing one spike at +1m but looks like a retry storm from a client. overall 5xx back down to 1.2%. continuing to monitor.

li: if canary holds at <2% for 10m we should promote to 25%. keep the rollout plan simple.

matt: agreed. promoting to 25% now.

deploy-bot: rollout to `25%` started. current health checks: 48/50 passing.

sasha: approved for rollforward to full if no regression in the next 15m.

ops-oncall: watching. if we hit rollback criteria i will `kubectl set image` back to `redwood/embed-service:v1.3.1` and notify here.

deploy-bot: rollout to `100%` started. finalizing.

matt: post-roll notes: full rollout complete, latency unchanged, 5xx at 0.5%. credit to li for the quick patch. will update internal changelog and tag release.

eric: leaving a note for the follow-up retro: add a quick pre-canary smoke that runs the tokenizer decode on a larger sample.

sasha: thanks all. closing expedited window. :white_check_mark:
